native_archive_location: Separate public data release; not embedded in the Git checkout or submission ZIP
native_scope: All 1,030 original prediction-score files and 39 saved internal-measurement files are available as eleven separate archives (https://github.com/Biodyn-AI/names-mechinterp/releases/tag/native-data-20261116-v1), covering both development and confirmation. The Git checkout and S1 Data provide the recorded answers, analysis inputs and checksum catalogs, not the large arrays. Archive-byte checks and replay of the saved mathematical calculations are separate procedures; the repository documents their scope and original runtime requirements. No model checkpoints or learned parameter tensors are redistributed.
